snippet.title: Dead Finger Dice: A Billionaire Killing Game - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX Summer Show
snippet.description: Play a sinister game of poker against blood-thirsty demon billionaires who’ve trapped you on their mega yacht. Meet the characters and check out the Dead Finger Dice: A Billionaire Killing Game trailer for this upcoming rogue-like dice builder game. Dead Finger Dice: A Billionaire Killing Game will be available on PC (Steam) in Summer 2025.
